d: We are hiring a licensed CPA for our finance team in Dubai. This on-site role suits a hands-on accountant with strong UAE accounting and tax experience who can own the month-end close and work independently.
⚠️ Please read before applying: We only consider candidates who meet all three of these requirements:
✅ At least 5 years of accounting experience in Dubai: required
q: At least 5 years of accounting experience in Dubai
Strong knowledge of UAE VAT and Corporate Tax
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field
Strong knowledge of IFRS and financial reporting
Experience with ERP systems and accounting software
Close attention to detail and the ability to meet deadlines
r: li
Own day-to-day accounting and financial operations, including the month-end close
li
Prepare accurate financial statements, management reports and financial analyses
li
Keep complete and accurate accounting records
li
Handle UAE VAT and Corporate Tax compliance and filings
li
Support budgeting, forecasting and financial planning
li
Work with external auditors and provide the financial documents they need
li
Monitor cash flow, receivables, payables and financial controls
li
Ensure compliance with IFRS and UAE regulations
li
Manage and maintain accounting processes in Odoo ERP, keeping data, reporting and controls accurate
li

li

d: You will be responsible for the efficient running of the department in line with Hyatt International's Corporate Strategies and brand standards, whilst meeting employee, guest and owner expectations

To provide the hotel’s Marketing and Sales employees with internal and external marketing intelligence to support informed decisions resulting in an increase in the hotel’s overall revenues and maximize profitability.
q: Ideally with a university degree in Marketing or Hospitality/Tourism management. An MBA would be an asset. Minimum 2 years' work experience as Marketing Manager or Marketing Analyst. Strategic orientation, as well as good problem solving, administrative and interpersonal skills are a must

d: Alomar Holding Company is a leading Saudi-based diversified group specializing in real estate development, property and asset management, and strategic business ventures.

We are seeking an experienced Operations Manager to oversee the company's day-to-day operations, including branches, production centers, workforce, and operational performance. The role is responsible for ensuring efficient operations, maintaining production quality, meeting delivery deadlines, controlling costs, and improving overall business performance.
The Operations Manager will lead operational teams, optimize production processes, enhance customer experience, and support the company's growth and expansion plans.
q: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field
7+ years of professional experience in operations management
Proven experience managing multiple branches, operational teams, and production facilities
Experience in retail operations, tailoring, garment manufacturing, or production-based businesses
Strong knowledge of production planning, quality control, inventory management, and cost control
Experience managing operational budgets, performance KPIs, and business efficiency
Strong leadership, problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ERP or operational management systems
Good command of Arabic and English
Experience in multi-branch retail operations and tailoring or garment production
Experience in business expansion and new branch openings
Experience in process improvement, automation, and operational systems
r: li
Oversee daily operations across all branches and production centers, ensuring operational efficiency, readiness, and compliance with company procedures
li
Manage production and tailoring operations, including order planning, workload distribution, productivity, quality, and delivery timelines
li
Monitor quality standards, customer satisfaction, complaints, and rework, and implement corrective actions to improve service quality
li
Monitor branch sales performance, targets, and profitability, and coordinate with marketing to support sales growth and commercial initiatives
li
Manage workforce planning, staffing, scheduling, employee performance, and productivity across branches and production teams
li
Monitor inventory, materials consumption, operational expenses, and production costs to ensure efficient resource utilization and cost control
li
Develop and standardize operational procedures, workflows, and performance KPIs across all branches and production centers
li
Analyze operational performance, prepare periodic reports, identify improvement opportunities, and implement corrective action plans
li
Coordinate with internal departments, including HR, Finance, Procurement, IT, and Marketing, to ensure smooth operations
li
Support business expansion, new branch openings, production capacity planning, and continuous improvement initiatives
x: Pension scheme in accordance with Saudi labor regulations
Paid annual leave and public holidays
